title: Esterházy papers, box 636: six digit-cipher documents of 1744, one from Maria Theresa (Slovak National Archives, fond Esterházi, čeklíska vetva)

steps.what: Read Antal et al., HistoCrypt 2023 (the published description): box 636 holds six 1744 digit-cipher documents (five French, one German; one from Maria Theresa), no plaintext; keys in the fonds and the HHStA/Hungarian keys the authors tried do not match.

Looked for images: HCPortal (local harvest to id 1499 plus a live scan of ids 1500-2032: nothing from the Slovak National Archives' Esterházy fonds), DECODE (no Slovak National Archives records). Extracted the only published image, Figure 6 of the paper.
Transcribed the cipher block of Figure 6: a letter headed 'Moscau ce 5e d'octobre 1744' to 'Votre Majesté', 11 lines, 176 groups.
157 distinct of 176 groups; values 7-1737 and 3018-3297, spread evenly over the hundreds; six groups under 100. A code of about 2,000 entries with almost every group seen once.

Opened the HHStA Chiffrenschlüssel key records of 1740-1746 on DECODE: R1594 (German circular 1745, values to 1500), R1597/R1596 (French circular 1745, encipher and decipher tables, values 101-1355), R1595 (circular table 100-1499), R1593 (1746 multi-table), R1562 (1743, values under 1000), R1574 (1740 German), R1644, R1691. None reaches the 1500-1737 and 3000-3297 values of the sample.

Web search for a reading of box 636 or the Moscow letter: none. Found the Dorotheum lot of 17 Dec 2024 (Maria Theresa to Esterházy, Vienna 31 July 1744), described as a three-digit word code whose key copy is in the Austrian State Archives.
Ciphertext-only attack not run: 176 groups from a code of about 2,000 entries, 89% of them distinct, give nothing for a solver to fit. Needs the other five documents or the 1744 key.

outcome.method_basis: Only 176 groups of one of the six documents are online (a figure in the 2023 paper); no 1740s HHStA key on DECODE covers their value range, and the box itself is not digitised.

gaps.item: the six box-636 documents (only 176 groups of one shown in print)
gaps.detail: scans exist at the Slovak National Archives (4160 x 6240 px) but are not published; order from SNA, fond Esterházi - čeklíska vetva, box 636
no DECODE key of 1740-1746 fits; candidates are the HHStA Staatskanzlei Russland/Sachsen keys of 1744, not on DECODE

outcome.notes: Closed attempted, open: blocked on images of box 636 and on the 1744 key.

prior.where: No reading of box 636 found (Antal et al. 2023; HCPortal records to id 1881, 9 Oct 2026; web). A sibling, Maria Theresa to N. Esterházy, Vienna 31 July 1744, was auctioned by Dorotheum on 17 Dec 2024 with a summary of its content from a key in the Austrian State Archives; it is not in box 636.
